title: Glowing top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc8800' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hatBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a3a8a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#7b4fc4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a2a75'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brim' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9b6fff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6a3fb8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='band' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='42' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='34' ry='10' fill='url(#brim)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#a67dff'/>

  <!-- Hat body (tall crown) -->
  <path d='M30 68 L28 22 Q28 18 34 18 L66 18 Q72 18 72 22 L70 68 Z' fill='url(#hatBody)'/>

  <!-- Left highlight on crown -->
  <path d='M34 22 L32 66 L38 66 L39 22 Z' fill='#8f63d6' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Right shadow edge -->
  <path d='M63 22 L62 66 L66 66 L66 22 Z' fill='#3d1f60' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x='28' y='55' width='44' height='10' rx='2' fill='url(#band)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='55' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x='44' y='53' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <rect x='47' y='56' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#7b4fc4'/>

  <!-- Crown top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#a07ae0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Soft glow lines around hat -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='40' ry='38' fill='none' stroke='#ffdd66' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='44' ry='42' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.2'/>
</svg>
